Legal exams 2025 CBI, SFIO, Com. Prosecutor  
Exam Guide and Study Plan  
UPSC Legal/Law Vacancies – Combined Recruitment Test for:  
1. 19 vacancies for the post of Assistant Public Prosecutor in CBI, Department of Personnel  
& Training, Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions. (SC-02, OBC-07, EWS-  
01, UR-09) [Adv. No. 12/2025, Vacancy No. 25081201223].  
2. 25 vacancies for the post of Public Prosecutor in CBI, Department of Personnel & Training,  
Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions. (SC-02, ST-01, OBC-08, EWS-02,  
UR-12) [Adv. No. 12/2025, Vacancy No. 25081202223]  
3. 25 vacancies for the post of Company Prosecutor in Ministry of Corporate Affairs (SC-  
06, ST-01, OBC-05, EWS-02, UR-11) (PwBD-01)* [Adv. No. 07/2025, Vacancy No.  
25060703214].  
4. 3 vacancies for the post of Assistant Director (Corporate Law) in Serious Fraud  
Investigation Office (SFIO), Ministry of Corporate Affairs (UR-03) (PwBD-01)* [Adv. No.  
07/2025, Vacancy No. 25060702214].  
5. 5 vacancies for the post of Assistant Legal Advisor in Directorate of Enforcement,  
Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance (SC-01, OBC-01, UR03) [Adv. No. 06/2025,  
Vacancy No. 25050622224].  
Exam Date  
COMBINED RECRUITMENT TEST for short-listing the candidates for the above mentioned posts  
on:  
•
•
•
Date: 11.01.2026 (11th January 2026)  
Day: SUNDAY (FORENOON SESSION)  
Time: from 10.00 A.M to 12.00 P.M.  
Exam Pattern  
The Recruitment Test will be used to shortlist candidates for interview. The weightage in the ratio of  
75:25 is accorded for marks in Recruitment Test and for marks in interview in determining final  
merit.  
•
•
•
•
•
Mode – Offline Pen and Paper based Test  
Duration – 2 hours  
Type – Objective, MCQ based  
Medium – English Only  
Marks – maximum of 300 marks; all questions will carry equal marks (No. of Qs is not  
mentioned; however, based on Recruitment Test of 2023 , 120 questions will be asked of 2.5  
marks each)  
•
Penalty for wrong answers - Every wrong answer will carry a deduction of one-third of the  
marks assigned to that question. If no answer is marked for a question, there will be no  
penalty for that question.

Syllabus  
Please Note: Syllabus released as follows  
1. The Constitution of India  
2. The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023  
3. The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023  
4. The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023  
5. The Information Technology Act, 2000  
6. The Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988  
7. The Companies Act, 2013  
8. The Central Vigilance Commission Act, 2003  
9. Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002  
10. The Delhi Special Police Establishment Act, 1946  
11. The Environment (Protection) Act, 1986  
12. The Competition Act, 2002

Suggestive Study Plan  
✓ The Study Plan given below focuses on the Recruitment Test  
✓ Time commitment: 7-8 hours daily (This may vary as per your preparation level and the score  
in Mock Tests)  
✓ You should write Section Test or Mock test regularly for revision. Analyse the tests you have  
attempted, and first focus on the questions which you answered incorrectly and then focus on  
all un-attempted questions - in each section.  
✓ At the end of each day, do analyse your whole day and make plan for the next day
